About Mikata

Mikata is a leader in healthcare technology, dedicated to enhancing patient outcomes and empowering healthcare professionals to deliver the highest standard of care. By integrating with EMRs, Mikata improves patient communication, offering automated reminders, follow-ups, and booking possibilities. Our flagship product, “Mika”, is a best-in-class AI Scribe software that reduces physician burnout by minimizing time spent on charting.

Mikata is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace.

Position Overview

As an AI Project Implementation Intern, you won’t just be supporting day-to-day tasks—you’ll play an active role in improving company-wide efficiency through AI-driven initiatives. You’ll work closely with the product team to help implement tools that streamline internal workflows and enhance the customer experience throughout the company. This is an in-person role based out of our Calgary office, with an internship duration of 4–12 months.

What You'll Do



- Improve Operational Efficiency: Assist other members of the team in implementing internal process improvements using AI-powered tools and automation
- Enable Training at Scale: Help design and implement AI-supported training tools for both customers and internal teams
- Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with team members to translate business needs into practical solutions

Key Responsibilities



- Contribute as an active member of cross-functional teams focused on operations, customer experience, and product enablement
- Assist in implementing AI-driven tools to improve internal workflows and operational efficiency
- Help build and maintain training materials and systems for customers and internal staff
- Gather feedback from internal teams and customers to improve tools and processes
- Document workflows, processes, and tool usage clearly for internal and external audiences
- Track basic metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of new tools and process improvements
- Support change management by helping teams adopt new systems and workflows
- Follow data privacy, security, and confidentiality standards

Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in or a recent graduate of a degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
- Strong interest in operations, process improvement, and using technology to drive efficiency
- Familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms, or chatbots is an asset
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Passion for healthcare innovation and improving customer and employee experiences

Why this role is a great fit for you



- Problem Solver: You enjoy breaking down messy processes and making them simpler and more efficient
- Tech-Curious: You’re excited about AI and eager to apply new tools in real-world business settings
- Self-Starter: You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and move projects forward
- Organized & Adaptable: You can manage multiple projects and adjust quickly in a fast-paced environment
- Clear Communicator: You can explain tools and processes to both technical and non-technical teammates

What We Offer

We offer a paid internship where your work directly impacts real patients and doctors. You’ll be mentored by senior leaders in the field and get a front-row seat to the scaling of a world-class AI product.

How To Apply

Interested candidates are asked to apply directly on our website through our job board. Additionally they are encouraged to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and why they are the ideal fit for this role.

Application Deadline

November 10th, 2026

Job Description

At American Express, we empower future technologists to learn, experiment, and make an impact from day one. As an AI Engineer Intern focused on AI Security Research in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a 16-week Summer Internship Program and contribute to hands-on projects at the intersection of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and software engineering. You’ll research emerging technologies, build working prototypes and proof-of-concepts, evaluate technical approaches, and learn how solutions are designed, tested, documented, and delivered in a global enterprise environment.

In this role, you may explore AI security, agentic AI, application security, generative AI and advanced AI models for cybersecurity, security automation, cloud security, secure software development, and other emerging technologies. You’ll work with AI engineers, cybersecurity engineers, researchers, architects, product partners, and business stakeholders to turn research ideas into code, experiments, measurable results, and reusable capabilities while applying responsible AI, security, privacy, and governance practices.

About The Team

Enterprise Technology Services teams build and operate technology that helps American Express deliver trusted, secure, and customer-first products and services. The AI Security Research team explores emerging AI and cybersecurity capabilities, develops prototypes and experimental environments, and evaluates how new technologies may be applied responsibly and securely in an enterprise setting.

As an undergraduate AI Engineer Intern, you’ll contribute at an early-career level with guidance from experienced engineers and researchers. You’ll gain practical experience investigating technical problems, building and testing solutions, analyzing results, and communicating findings to technical and non-technical partners.

Responsibilities

What type of work can you expect? How will you make an impact  in  this role?



-  Research emerging artificial intelligence and cybersecurity technologies, threats, techniques, and security capabilities with guidance from experienced engineers and researchers. 
-  Build prototypes, proof-of-concepts, security test harnesses, and experimental environments using Python and other modern programming languages. 
-  Assist in developing and testing AI and agentic AI solutions, including LLM integrations, AI agents, tool calling, orchestration frameworks, retrieval patterns, and automated workflows. 
-  Experiment with AI models for cybersecurity and software engineering use cases such as security analysis, threat detection, vulnerability research, application security testing, and automation. 
-  Integrate APIs, AI models, security tools, cloud services, containers, data sources, and development environments to support research and prototyping. 
-  Develop test cases, benchmarks, and experiments to evaluate solution effectiveness, reliability, security, limitations, and potential enterprise applications. 
-  Support hands-on evaluations of open-source technologies, products, platforms, and emerging technical capabilities, helping validate technical claims through testing and analysis. 
-  Analyze experimental results and document findings, assumptions, risks, technical limitations, and recommendations while following responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, and compliance expectations. 
-  Prepare technical documentation, research summaries, demonstrations, and presentations; share findings with AI, cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders; and participate in Agile team practices and code reviews. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications 



-  Currently enrolled in a full-time Bachelor’s degree program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or another related technical field. 
-  Students must have a graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. 
-  Hands-on programming experience, preferably with Python, and exposure to one or more languages such as Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, C/C++, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies. 
-  Foundational understanding of computer science and software engineering concepts, including data structures, algorithms, APIs, debugging, testing, version control, and problem solving. 
-  Foundational understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or related concepts through coursework, research, projects, labs, or extracurricular activities. 
-  Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles, threats, vulnerabilities, security controls, application security, cloud security, threat modeling, or secure software development practices. 
-  Ability to learn new technologies, investigate technical problems, build or test working solutions, analyze results, and document findings with appropriate guidance. 
-  Strong analytical, problem-solving, written and verbal communication, collaboration, curiosity, and learning agility with the ability to work effectively in a research and engineering team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications



-  Demonstrated hands on experience through academic coursework, research, personal projects, open-source contributions, security labs, hackathons, Capture-the-Flag competitions, or other extracurricular technical work. Previous internship experience is not required. 
-  Interest in the intersection of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, software engineering, and emerging technologies, including AI security, agent security, application security, cloud security, security automation, or secure AI enabled software development. 
-  Experience building software projects, prototypes, proof-of-concepts, research experiments, test harnesses, intelligent assistants, AI agents, agentic workflows, or hackathon solutions. 
-  Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, tool or function calling, orchestration frameworks, model evaluation, or human-in-the-loop review. 
-  Exposure to security research or testing techniques such as threat modeling, vulnerability research, AI red teaming, automated security testing, agent security testing, or evaluation of AI-native cybersecurity tools. 
-  Familiarity with APIs, cloud platforms, containers, data pipelines, development environments, security tools, or software integration patterns. 
-  Experience designing test cases, benchmarks, experiments, or technical evaluations and using evidence to summarize effectiveness, limitations, risks, and recommendations. 
-  Awareness of secure software development, responsible AI, data protection, privacy, governance, compliance, and responsible handling of sensitive information. 
-  Strong initiative, responsible judgment, attention to detail, presentation skills, and comfort working collaboratively in an experimental, fast learning environment. 

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:



- Competitive base salaries
- Flexible work arrangements and schedules with hybrid and virtual options with Amex Flex
- Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
- Career development and training opportunities

American Express is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible work environment in which all people who apply for positions or who work for or on behalf of Amex are treated with dignity and respect and are provided with equal treatment with respect to employment, regardless of that person's age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, race, colour, ancestry, ethnic or national origin, citizenship, religion or creed, marital status, family status, pregnancy, disability, record of offences, social condition or origin, political beliefs, association or activity or other factors prohibited under applicable Human Rights legislation (the “Prohibited Grounds”). If you have a disability and need accommodation, please speak with the Recruiter for more information.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

The below represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we’ll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.
